subject: pharmacology
title: Chelators and antidotes: metals, cyanide, alcohols and overdoses

steps.tx: **Lead** (**Burton gum lines**, **basophilic stippling**, Fanconi, wrist drop adults, encephalopathy children; **dimercaprol with EDTA** severe, **succimer oral** children moderate) with **mercury and arsenic** (**dimercaprol BAL**, succimer, **chelation challenge** urine lead mobilisation) chelates; iron overload (deferoxamine per haematinics wave) parallels. Abdominal X-ray chips lavage selected; levels with renal gate courses.
steps.say: Blue gums dotted red cells wrist drops is lead: succimer kids oral, BAL EDTA severe. Challenge urines mobilise.

steps.tx: **Cyanide** (bitter almond, lactate gap, cherry red; **amyl with sodium nitrite plus thiosulfate**, **hydroxocobalamin safer** red skin and urine) with **carbon monoxide** (**100 percent oxygen** half life, **hyperbaric** severe pregnancy and neuro, cherry red misleading) antidotes; smoke inhalation both suspected. Lactate with carboxyhaemoglobin gates; thiosulfate sulfur donates.
steps.say: Bitter almond lactate gap is cyanide: hydroxocobalamin reddens safest. CO 100 percent O2 hyperbarics severe.

steps.tx: **Methanol and ethylene glycol** (**formate blindness** with putamen, **oxalate kidneys**; **fomepizole** preferred, ethanol alternative, **dialysis** severe with bicarbonate) with **organophosphates** (**SLUDGE with bronchorrhoea**, miosis, fasciculations; **atropine plus pralidoxime before ageing**, benzodiazepine seizures, **intermediate syndrome** ventilation) poison; osmolal gap with anion gap metabolic acidosis warns. Cholinesterase levels follow.
steps.say: Blind formate putamen is methanol: fomepizole dialyses severe. SLUDGE drooling miosis: atropine pralidoxime pre ageing.

vis.alt: Composite image showing putamen lesions from methanol, miosis/bronchorrhea from organophosphates, and oxalate crystals from ethylene glycol.

steps.tx: **Paracetamol** (**NAC 150 50 100**, **Rumack-Matthew** nomogram, delayed fulminant) with **salicylates** (**urinary alkalinisation**, dialysis severe, tinnitus hyperventilating) and **iron tablets acute** (**deferoxamine** shock with X-ray tablets) overdoses; **digoxin Fab** (hyperkalaemia with AV block), **warfarin** (vitamin K with 4F-PCC), **dabigatran idarucizumab**, **heparin protamine**, **benzodiazepine flumazenil** selective, **opioid naloxone**, **TCA bicarbonate**, **CCB and beta blocker high dose insulin with glucagon calcium lipid** reverse. Toxidromes route.
steps.say: Paracetamol nomograms NAC 150 50 100; salicylates alkalinise dialysing severe. Fab, PCC, naloxone reverse.
